headlines.description: — Alex Bregman hit his 25th homer and doubled among three hits, Shota Imanaga tossed six effective innings and the Chicago Cubs pounded the Pittsburgh Pirates 12-2 on Friday to end a four-game slide.
headlines.shortLinkText: Alex Bregman hits his 25th homer and the Cubs pound the Pirates 12-2 to end their 4-game skid

headlines.description: — Riley Greene had three hits, Dillon Dingler homered and the Detroit Tigers beat the Colorado Rockies 6-2 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Greene has 3 hits and Dingler hits slump-breaking homer in Tigers' 6-2 win over Rockies

events.name: Los Angeles Angels at Washington Nationals

headlines.description: — Jorbit Vivas hit a tiebreaking two-run double in the eighth inning to lift Washington to a 4-3 victory over the Los Angeles Angels that snapped the Nationals' seven-game losing streak Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nationals score 3 in the 8th, rally for a 4-3 win over the Angels to snap their 7-game skid

events.name: New York Mets at New York Yankees

headlines.description: — Cody Bellinger hit a three-run homer in the second inning off rookie Nolan McLean, and the New York Yankees beat the New York Mets 6-4 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bellinger hits 3-run homer as Yankees beat Mets 6-4 on 25th anniversary of 9/11

events.name: Baltimore Orioles at Toronto Blue Jays

headlines.description: — Dylan Beavers hit his first career leadoff home run, Coby Mayo added a solo blast and the Baltimore Orioles beat the Toronto Blue Jays 7-4 on Friday night in the opener of a series between AL wild-card contenders.
headlines.shortLinkText: Beavers hits leadoff homer, Mayo also connects as Orioles beat Blue Jays 7-4

events.name: Houston Astros at Tampa Bay Rays

headlines.description: — Junior Caminero hit a game-ending, two-run homer in the ninth inning, and the Tampa Bay Rays clinched a playoff berth with a 3-1 victory over...
headlines.shortLinkText: Junior Caminero's walk-off homer sends Rays to playoff-clinching 3-1 win over Astros

events.name: Kansas City Royals at Boston Red Sox

headlines.description: — Carter Jenson had a two-run double, Salvador Perez added an RBI and the Kansas City Royals beat the Boston Red Sox 3-2 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Carter Jensen has a 2-run double in the Royals' 3-2 victory over the Red Sox

events.name: Los Angeles Dodgers at Miami Marlins

headlines.description: — Kyle Tucker hit his sixth career grand slam and fell a double shy of the cycle as the Los Angeles Dodgers beat the Miami Marlins 6-2 on Friday night to stretch their season-best winning streak to eight games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kyle Tucker's grand slam helps Dodgers beat Marlins 6-2 for 8th straight win

headlines.description: — Drake Baldwin doubled to center field in the 11th inning to score Ha-Seong Kim from first base and the Atlanta Braves beat the Philadelphia Phillies 6-5 on Friday night in the opening game of a key NL East series.
headlines.shortLinkText: Braves outlast Phillies 6-5 in 11 innings in opener of key NL East series

headlines.description: — Garrett Mitchell hit the Brewers’ first grand slam of the season, one of four homers for Milwaukee in a 20-0 rout of the Cincinnati Reds on Friday night that clinched a playoff spot for the majors' best team.
headlines.shortLinkText: Garrett Mitchell hits grand slam and MLB-best Brewers pound Reds 20-0 to clinch playoff spot

headlines.description: — Angel Martínez hit a two-run homer and his double in the ninth inning keyed the game-winning rally as the Cleveland Guardians beat the Minnesota Twins 5-2 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Angel Martinez homers and doubles as Guardians rally to beat Twins 5-2

events.name: Chicago White Sox at St. Louis Cardinals

headlines.description: — Rookies Joshua Báez and Leo Bernal each had three hits and drove in two runs, and the St. Louis Cardinals overcame a pair home runs by Chase Meidroth to beat the Chicago White Sox 7-3 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rookies Báez and Bernal lead Cardinals to 7-3 win over White Sox

headlines.description: — Donovan Walton hit a walk-off two-run homer in the 10th inning to give the Athletics a 6-5 victory over the Seattle Mariners on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Donovan Walton hits a 10th-inning walk-off 2-run homer as the Athletics beat the Mariners 6-5

headlines.description: — Ketel Marte had two doubles and three RBI to please the Chase Field crowd, Corbin Carroll added a two-run homer and the Arizona Diamondbacks beat the Texas Rangers 9-1 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ketel Marte has 3 RBIs to earn big cheers from Chase Field crowd, Diamondbacks beat Rangers 9-1

events.name: San Diego Padres at San Francisco Giants

headlines.description: — Former Giants pitcher Robbie Ray threw five innings for his 100th career victory and the San Diego Padres extended their winning streak to five games with a 7-5 decision over San Francisco on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ray gets 100th career win as Padres hold off Giants 7-5 to maintain wild-card edge
